seo.title: El Aleph Phinisi: Private Yacht Charter in Indonesia
seo.description: El Aleph, a 39m two-masted phinisi built by Konjo builders in 2008 and refitted by Rascal Voyages in 2025: five cabins, 13 crew. Charter from US$12,000 a night.

tagline: The largest of the Rascal yachts: a 39-metre two-masted phinisi, refitted in 2025, chartered whole
answer: El Aleph is a 39-metre traditional handmade phinisi with two masts, built of ironwood in 2008 at Serangan by Konjo boat builders from Tana Beru and refurbished by Rascal Voyages in 2025. She takes up to 10 guests in five en-suite cabins (the fleet page says 11) with a crew of 13 and a PADI dive instructor, and charters whole only, from US$12,000 a night plus taxes.

overview: El Aleph is a traditional handmade phinisi, built of ironwood at Serangan in 2008 by Konjo boat builders from Tana Beru village. At 39 metres with a 9 metre beam she is the largest of the three Rascal Voyages yachts, and the only one with two masts. Rascal Voyages refurbished her interiors in 2025 with lighter teak, antiques and handwoven textures in what it calls an "Archipelago Chic" aesthetic.

The Master Cabin is the only cabin above deck: 7.5 by 4 metres with a super king bed, a dressing room, a walk-in wardrobe and a private terrace. Below are four more: Cabins 3 and 4 with queen beds and daybeds, and Cabins 1 and 2, set up as a queen or as twins, which can be interconnected. The plan also shows a nanny cabin. Thirteen crew sail her.

Her main deck holds an air-conditioned saloon that seats ten, an outdoor lounge, an open-air dining area and a sun lounge with four daybeds. Rascal Voyages sells her as a private charter only, at a published US$12,000 a night.
why: She gives a group the most space of any Rascal yacht at the same published rate as Rascal: a 39-metre hull, five deck areas, a dressing room and terrace in the Master and a nanny cabin on the plan.
Cabins 1 and 2 can be set as twins and interconnected, which suits a family with children who want to be close.

routesNote: Rascal Voyages sells El Aleph as a private charter and sets her route with each party. The two charter journeys below show a typical week in Komodo and in Raja Ampat and Misool.
charterBasis: a night for the whole yacht, plus taxes
faqs: How much does it cost to charter El Aleph?
Rascal Voyages publishes US$12,000 a night plus taxes for the whole yacht. James confirms what is included for your route and dates.
Can we book a single cabin on El Aleph?
No. Rascal Voyages lists no cabin rate for her: she is a private charter only. Its cabin voyages run on Rascal and Rebel.
How many guests does El Aleph take?
Up to 10 in five en-suite cabins per her yacht information; Rascal Voyages' fleet page gives 11. The plan also shows a nanny cabin. James confirms the number for your party.
She is 39 metres overall with a 9 metre beam and a 3.4 metre draft, the largest of the three Rascal yachts, with a crew of 13.
Is El Aleph good for families?
Cabins 1 and 2 can be set as twins and interconnected, the plan shows a nanny cabin, and Rascal Voyages says it welcomes "little Rascals". No minimum age is published.
Is there diving aboard El Aleph?
Yes: full scuba equipment and an onboard PADI dive instructor, with certification on request.
